name: ModelVariant767_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant767_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (two bursts in front of the slot, each drawing a growing cloud of animated smoke puffs, a widening ring, a four-point star, embers and debris while shaking the camera and optionally flashing the screen); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, builds the ring, ember and debris points and packs three texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 4 when the first burst starts, 1 when the second starts, 2 once the last smoke puff has finished and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-784 and 881 images build it from the same source. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
